title: 'Rock wa Lady no Tashinami deshite' Creator Launches New Manga
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of Comic Heaven announced on Friday that manga creator Hiroshi Fukuda will launch a new manga, titled Koko wa Kagari no Territory (Here is Kagari's territory), in the magazine next issue, scheduled for a November 30 release.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Charisma TV Anime Reveals January 7 Debut in Teaser Video
content: The staff for the television anime of Evil Line Records label ( Hypnosis Mic ) and the intellectual property company Dazed's Chōjin-teki Share House Story Charisma (Superhuman Shared Residence Story: Charisma) project began streaming the anime's teaser promotional video on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Rock is a Lady's Modesty's Hiroshi Fukuda Launches New Manga
content: The 108th issue of Nihonbungeisha 's Comic Heaven magazine announced on Friday Hiroshi Fukuda will launch a new manga titled Koko wa Kagari no Territory (Here is Kagari's Territory) in the next issue on November 30.
author: ANN

title: Acorn UK Blu-ray of Hell Mode Listed on Amazon for January
content: Acorn had previously released two anime Blu-rays on October 26: My Gift Lvl 9999 Unlimited Gacha: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon, I'm Out for Revenge! and Sword of the Demon Hunter .
author: ANN

title: Fool Night Anime Streams in India on November 26
content: Netflix is listing the television anime of Kasumi Yasuda 's Fool Night manga for release in India on November 26. Netflix will debut the entire series worldwide on November 26. Atsuyuki Yukawa ( Suzume unit director) is directing the anime at Sunrise and SHAFT . Jin Tanaka ( Oshi no Ko ) is writing the script.
author: ANN

title: Indian Manga Duo masterlynx's Kung Fu Kung Fool Manga Releases in English
content: KadoComi 's " Kadokawa World Manga" label dedicated to English releases of ongoing manga series released Indian manga creator duo masterlynx's Kung Fu Kung Fool manga in English on Friday. The label offers the opening and latest chapters of selected series for free in English for international audiences.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Streams Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3 Anime in India in January 2027
content: Crunchyroll announced on Thursday that it will stream Mashle: Magic and Muscles - Tri-Magicathalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc , the third season based on Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga, in January in January 2027.
author: ANN

title: Three Ghibli Blu-ray Steelbooks Listed For December 7
content: The home releases bear the GKIDS logo. title: Idoly Pride Game Ends Service on March 1
content: The official Twitter account for the Idoly Pride multimedia project announced on Friday the game will end service on March 1. The game will update with an offline version. The original game launched in June 2021 for iOS and Android devices.
author: ANN

title: 'Shibatsuki Bukken' Gets TV Anime Adaptation in Summer 2027
content: Publishing company Shueisha announced a television anime adaptation of Esu Omori 's Shibatsuki Bukken ( Shiba Inu Rooms ) on Sunday. An official website also opened and revealed the main staff, cast, a teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video. The anime is scheduled to air in Summer 2027.
author: MyAnimeList
